review.scope: Actual additive-free agricultural urea round tablets mechanically compacted from compatible virgin NH3/CO2 urea, with actual preparation, screening, fines recycle, dry dust handling and packing through unique first acceptance.
review.source_and_method: Root examined actual IFDC2014 PDF5/printed2 including the round-tablet images and explicit no-other-ingredient compaction statement, independent configurable OEM line context, complete current CPC3 introduction application principles, HS2022 chapter31 and historical explicit CPC2.1/HS3105.10 linkage. No dimensions, tablet weights, yield, packaging threshold, dose or agronomic benefit adopted. EPA2017 Method17 is conditional unheated in-stack gravimetry: actual urea recovery/moisture/induced-change, temperature independence, dry unsaturated non-droplet gas, geometry and complete Methods1/2/3/5 dependencies must qualify. Historical subsection discrepancies remain explicit, without invented concordance or current regulatory-compliance claim.
review.native_and_classification: Actual full Urea state100 whole ProductMass/kg has CAS57-13-6, agricultural virgin ammonia/CO2 synthesis restrictions, but no granule-only or geographic restriction. Additive-free mechanical form retains whole chemical identity. Native34611 and the newNK split are explicit counterevidence. Current CPC3 §§50/55 and unchanged application principles plus unchanged34659 label, actual tablet form, currentHS3105.10 form exception and historical explicit relation support a labeled current continuity inference, not a current official product ruling or all-urea mapping. Prior scope hold retained as history; specific round-tablet evidence repairs this case only.
review.event_stock_accounting: Original unique first acceptance Q and disjoint net fate bridge, full stocks and inherited WIP once, actual whole contaminated exports and non-overlapping provider service demand, separate asset/packaging physical fleets, actual quantities and original cohorts retained.
review.bilingual: Complete EN/ZH meaning and supported source/ancestor units reviewed; typed rules, calculations, quality and twelve-field protocols, source/use and ordered qualifiers compared.
review.remaining_limits: Actual providers, quantities, grades, full applicable site/matrix method qualification and unbound ordinary identities remain explicit study obligations. No generic-category proxy or empirical default; finite checks do not establish scientific approval or complete plant data.
